To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the coupled inverse design method and constraint optimization algorithm has successfully been implemented and tested over the NACAs 65-410 and 65-012 airfoils.
the coupled system of inverse design method with constrained optimization is capable of finding the optimum pressure distribution for a given flow condition.
a novel method for inverse design and optimization of airfoils has been developed, tested and validated for strong adverse pressure gradient cases.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an efficient numerical tool for the inverse design of the two dimensional airfoils at strong adverse pressure conditions.
developing an efficient numerical tool for solving the coupled problem of the inverse and optimization.
the development of an optimization based inverse design method to modify the airfoil surface for achieving the optimum pressure distribution on the surface.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the coupled problem of the inverse, wall modification design with the constrained SQP optimization has been successfully completed.
a coupled system of inverse design with constraint optimization is successfully developed, validated and applied over the NACA airfoil.
the developed coupled system of the direct and inverse design algorithms is capable of completing the optimization process of the strong adverse pressure gradient airfoil.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the inverse design method is a very useful tool to complete the design process.

a new method is developed to evaluate the optimal pressure distribution at the strong adverse pressure gradient flows and a new coupled method is developed for completing wall surface modification till reaching the optimal pressure distribution.
the developed inverse design and constraint optimizer is a powerful tool that can be used to solve complex inverse design problems with a high level of confidence.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the inverse design method is capable of completing wall surface modification till optimum target pressure distribution and hence, the lift coefficient is reached.
the coupled system of optimization and inverse design method is capable of completing the optimum design of airfoils with strong adverse pressure gradient conditions.

the inverse method is capable to complete the wall modification for the given target pressure distribution and the constraint optimization is capable to find the optimum target pressure distributions.
